description: This file defines a Java class 'LoanTransactionBusinessEvent' that extends 'BusinessEvent' and models an external event related to loan transactions in the system. It includes transaction details such as amount, outstanding balance, principal, interest, fees, and penalties, with methods to verify the correctness of external event responses.

classes.name: LoanTransactionBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents an external business event for a loan transaction, containing financial details and verification logic.

methods.description: Verifies that the external event payload matches the internal state of the event object, using provided formatter for date comparison.
